symbols.name: APNSHeaders
signatures:
type APNSHeaders struct {
	PushType   string `json:"apns-push-type"`
	Topic      string `json:"apns-topic"`
	Priority   string `json:"apns-priority"`
	Expiration string `json:"apns-expiration"`
	CollapseID string `json:"apns-collapse-id,omitempty"`
}
symbols.docs: APNSHeaders are an APNs request's HTTP/2 headers, named by their JSON tags.

members.name: PushType
members.docs: PushType is "alert" or "voip".

members.name: Topic
members.docs: Topic is the bundle ID for alerts and \<bundle ID>.voip for VoIP pushes.

members.name: Priority
members.docs: Priority is "10".

members.name: Expiration
members.docs: Expiration is the Unix seconds after which APNs stops trying to deliver.

members.name: CollapseID
members.docs: CollapseID is set for incoming and missed calls: the ring's collapse key, so a missed-call alert replaces the ring's incoming-call alert.

symbols.name: APNSRequest
symbols.docs: APNSRequest is an APNs request. Your APNs client adds authorization and sends it to /3/device/\<token>.

members.name: Payload
members.docs: Payload is the request body as canonical JSON. Send it as it is.

symbols.name: Error
symbols.docs: Error is a request that couldn't be built. Its message names the field but never contains its value.

members.name: Is
members.docs: Is reports whether target is the error's `Code`.

symbols.name: FCMAndroidConfig
symbols.docs: FCMAndroidConfig is an FCM message's Android delivery options.

members.name: Priority
members.docs: Priority is "HIGH".

members.name: TTL
members.docs: TTL is the remaining lifetime, such as "3600s".

members.name: CollapseKey
members.docs: CollapseKey is set for calls and cancellations: the ring's collapse key.

symbols.name: FCMMessage
symbols.docs: FCMMessage is an FCM data message.

members.name: Data
members.docs: Data has one key, "convohop": the metadata as canonical JSON.

members.name: Android
members.docs: Android is the REST API's form. Firebase Admin SDKs take it in their own form, such as a TTL duration.

symbols.name: FCMRequest
symbols.docs: FCMRequest is the body of an FCM HTTP v1 messages:send request without a target: add message.token or message.fid before you send it.

symbols.name: WebPushHeaders
symbols.docs: WebPushHeaders are a Web Push message's headers, named by their JSON tags.

members.name: TTL
members.docs: TTL is the remaining lifetime in seconds.

members.name: Urgency
members.docs: Urgency is "normal" for messages and "high" for calls and cancellations.

members.name: Topic
members.docs: Topic is set for calls and cancellations: the ring's collapse key.

symbols.name: WebPushRequest
symbols.docs: WebPushRequest is a Web Push message for your Web Push library, which encrypts the payload (RFC 8291) and signs the request (VAPID).

members.name: Headers
members.docs: Headers are RFC 8030 headers. Where your library sets TTL, Urgency or Topic from its own options, pass the values there, or its defaults replace them.

members.name: Payload
members.docs: Payload is the plaintext as canonical JSON. Encrypt it as it is.

symbols.name: Code
symbols.docs: Code is why a request couldn't be built. Code implements error so that errors.Is(err, CodeInvalidEvent) matches an `*Error` with that code.

members.name: CodeInvalidOptions
members.docs: CodeInvalidOptions means an option is nil or invalid: a title or body that isn't valid UTF-8, a nil clock, or a bundle ID that isn't an app bundle ID. Options are checked first.

members.name: CodeInvalidEvent
members.docs: CodeInvalidEvent means the event doesn't match the push payload contract.

members.name: Error
members.docs: Error returns the code as an error message.

symbols.name: APNSAlert
signatures: func APNSAlert(event *webhooks.Notification, bundleID string, options ...Option) (*APNSRequest, error)
symbols.docs: APNSAlert builds an APNs alert for a message, an incoming call or a missed call (a cancellation with reason ended or expired), and returns nil for other cancellations. The payload is at most 4096 bytes. bundleID is the app's bundle ID, the alert's topic.

symbols.name: APNSVoIP
signatures: func APNSVoIP(event *webhooks.Notification, bundleID string, options ...Option) (*APNSRequest, error)
symbols.docs: APNSVoIP builds an APNs VoIP push for an incoming call, and returns nil for other events. iOS requires you to report every VoIP push to CallKit as a call. The payload is at most 5120 bytes. bundleID is the app's bundle ID; the push's topic is \<bundleID>.voip.

symbols.name: FCM
symbols.docs: FCM builds an FCM data message for any notification event. Its data, as JSON, is at most 4096 bytes.

symbols.name: WebPush
symbols.docs: WebPush builds a Web Push message for any notification event. The payload is at most 3993 bytes, the RFC 8291 plaintext limit.

symbols.name: WithBody
symbols.docs: WithBody sets the visible body. It replaces a message event's preview. An empty body is omitted.

symbols.name: WithClock
symbols.docs: WithClock replaces time.Now for the TTL and expiration. Use it in tests.

symbols.name: WithTitle
symbols.docs: WithTitle sets the visible title, such as the sender's or the conversation's name. An empty title is omitted.

symbols.name: WithoutPreview
symbols.docs: WithoutPreview stops a message event's preview from becoming the body when there is no `WithBody`.
